scope: Proposition 6.3 (Cap selection) of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-with-local-conservation-for-the-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 363 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640850bc08703544), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For fixed δ > 0, there are s̄0, T0 > 0, uniform in N and the collision cutoff, with the following property. For each 0 < s0 ≤ s̄0, each 0 < T ≤ T0, and each finite approximation, a seed parameter λ ∈ (0, L0) gives a solution on [0, T] satisfying Z(t) ≤ mT (t + sN ) (0 ≤ t ≤ T), max 0≤t≤T Z(t) mT (t + sN ) = 1. (6.6) The dormant solution exists on a fixed initial interval and satisfies Z(t) ≤ C′ A,δtA . (6.7) The interval and constant in (6.7) are independent of N, the collision cutoff, and sufficiently small s0.
